Punching Poliwrath (Japanese: VSニョロボン VS ) is the 66th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 26th chapter of the .

==Plot==
 
The chapter begins with Daisy Oak taking care of a . Suddenly, comes in, outraged with what is happening to Pewter City, Cerulean City, and Celadon City. Oak looks out of the lab at the burning cities as Misty is trying to defeat multiple in Cerulean City.

Meanwhile on Cerise Island, , his , and meet with Lt. Surge and his , Sabrina and her , and Koga and his . Farther in the island, Lance orders Lorelei to call Bruno (who is looking to challenge back). Meanwhile, Bruno has a flashback about his battle with Red. In the flashback, Red is calling Bruno, when suddenly the cliff he is on breaks. Bruno sends out his , and it battles Pika. Pika is defeated and Hitmonlee is called back. Red sends out Poli and Bruno sends out . Using and , Poli is defeated. Now it is Gyara vs. . As the two battle, Lorelei has a flashback about how she and Agatha met.

==Major events==
Misty tries to save her city from the .
In a flashback, the battle between and Bruno starts.
